## Overview

A small pill/chip used for tags, categories, cuisines and status labels.
Use the default slot to prefix the label with an icon.

## Properties

| Property             | Attribute | Description                  | Type                                                          | Default     |
| -------------------- | --------- | ---------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------- |
| `label` _(required)_ | `label`   | Text shown inside the badge. | `string`                                                      | `undefined` |
| `variant`            | `variant` | Visual style variant.        | `"area" \| "category" \| "default" \| "success" \| "warning"` | `'default'` |
